title: Spring Boot actuator mappings are exposed
summary: The /actuator/mappings endpoint lists every route the application serves, mapping its whole surface for an attacker.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and body_contains("dispatcherServlet") and body_contains("mappings") and body_differs(control)

remediate: Secure the actuator endpoints in production.
